caketext_collector.title: CakeText Collector
caketext_collector.command.exported: Wrote the Crowdin files to exports/crowdin/%s (click to open). Check them before you share them.
caketext_collector.option.enabled.tip: Record new server text (never player chat or player names) into config/caketext/collected. Nothing is uploaded.
caketext_collector.option.format.tip: .json.gz is the same JSON, gzip-compressed: several times smaller, and the translator reads both.
caketext_collector.option.positions.tip: Store where each string was seen (16-block cell; exact block for nameplates), so translators can tell same text in different places apart.
caketext_collector.option.export_positio: Include block positions in exports. Turn off if you'd rather not share where you've been.
caketext_collector.option.export.tip: Writes exports/crowdin/<server>/: an English .pot per surface (chat, tooltip, nameplate…) with where each string was seen as translator notes, plus a crowdin.yml. Every string is included, so Crowdin never drops a translated one.
caketext_collector.sources.title: What to collect
modmenu.descriptionTranslation.caketext-: Collects the text a server shows into local strings files for translators, with where it was seen. Player names and player chat are never stored, and nothing is uploaded.
caketext_collector.option.auto_export.ti: Keeps the Crowdin files in exports/crowdin/<server>/ up to date by itself: every %s minutes, when you leave a server and when you quit.
